purpose: Required targeted save/migration cases before T5.1 can be certified.

cases.setup: Save v0.14 has pendingEventId=legacyId; crosswalk decision is same_scene_rewrite_and_id_migration and full semantic identity is approved.
expected: Resume succeeds.
Pending choice labels/intents are unchanged from what the player had already seen.
No narrative RNG draw occurs during migration/resume.
Pending ID becomes canonical or is transparently resolved through an equivalent compatibility record.
Revision/idempotency guarantees remain intact.

cases.setup: Save has a pending legacy event whose mapping is unresolved or only thematically similar.
expected: Migration must not substitute an arbitrary canonical event.
Preferred: legacy compatibility definition resolves the already-presented scene.
Otherwise resume fails explicitly with a migration/content compatibility error.
No canonical SEEN flag is manufactured.

cases.setup: Save history contains a legacy technical event retired from active canonical scheduling.
expected: Historical record remains truthful and readable.
Active scheduler does not schedule the retired legacy ID again.
No unrelated canonical SEEN flag is created.
Epilogue/history rendering still tolerates legacy ID.

cases.setup: Legacy event created a seed whose semantic memory remains valid, but the canonical origin ID changes.
expected: Seed state/intensity is preserved if semantically valid.
originEvent metadata changes only when same-scene origin responsibility is reviewed.
Consumer eligibility remains deterministic after resume.

cases.setup: Legacy technical event created a seed that belongs canonically to a different scene/age.
expected: Do not relabel old history as having seen the canonical scene.
Migration may preserve the memory state only if an explicit compatibility rule documents why.
Future canonical scene is not suppressed by a fake SEEN flag.
No double-origin side effect occurs when the canonical scene later happens.

cases.setup: Event ID is already canonical but body/choices/seeds are repaired to match canon.
expected: Old completed history stays completed under that same ID.
A pending decision requires compatibility review because displayed labels may differ.
contentIdentity change is handled explicitly.
No automatic replay of already-completed event.

cases.setup: Canonical repair changes serialized event definitions and therefore contentIdentity.
expected: Do not disable or weaken contentIdentity validation.
Migration path explicitly recognizes supported legacy content identities/builds.
Unsupported identity fails transparently.
Post-migration snapshot stores new canonical content identity.

cases.setup: Legacy save contains command receipts/journal around a migrated decision.
expected: Previously committed command remains idempotent.
Migration does not duplicate choice effects.
expectedRevision semantics remain valid.

cases.setup: Same pre-migration save is migrated twice with identical content and seed.
expected: narrative/football/microfeed/qa states are identical after migration.
Migration itself consumes no RNG.
Microfeed on/off does not alter strong narrative result.

cases.setup: A seed created before save is consumed years later after one or more save/resume cycles.
expected: Canonical consumer remains eligible when conditions match.
Seed metadata/history still identifies the causal path truthfully.
Outcome matches deterministic control run.

cases.setup: Save occurs at retirement.status=decided before announcement.
expected: Resume returns to announcement/career flow, never directly epilogue.
Announcement can occur exactly once.

cases.setup: Save occurs at retirement.status=announced before final closure.
expected: Resume preserves announced state.
Last-match/no-last-match closure remains available according to canon.
No second announcement.
Resume opens epilogue.
No new sporting event is scheduled.
Epilogue facts match stored closure shape/history.

cases.setup: Late free-agent market is weak/silent but EVT_38_MARKET_001-equivalent decision remains eligible.
expected: Do not auto-close retirement before presenting player choices.
Lower salary/level, wait, home-contact and retire routes remain distinct.
Only explicit retirement or exhausted/defined terminal condition advances decision state.

cases.setup: UI/history renders a migrated save containing IDs no longer active in canonical catalog.
expected: No crash or missing-reference corruption.
Legacy label can be rendered from compatibility metadata.
Legacy record is not presented as a canonical scene unless proven same-scene.
